floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Sei Saadiyat floor plan
floorPlans.note: These sheets identify layout types without publishing a measured area for each drawing. Confirm the signed plan and area for the residence you choose.

review.images: Reviewed the Aldar launch gallery and corporate project page. The daytime and dusk tower renders come from the latter. The gallery pairs exterior, residence and shared amenity scenes. Corporate page: https://www.aldar.com/properties/en/uae/saadiyat-island/sei-saadiyat
review.location: Visually checked brochure physical page 8, including the outlined project boundary and original destination labels and times. Six regional minutes agree with the Aldar launch page. The brochure does not publish a specific entrance pin. The map uses the entire original page and the directions link uses the verified project name and district.
review.floorPlans: Original floor-plan and brochure copies matched their previously reviewed hashes. Checked all 45 plan-document pages, with full-size residence drawings on physical pages 6–12. Retained the complete apartment and loft spreads. Tower floor plates remain available in the original PDF. No precise area is assigned to any drawing because the residence pages do not print one.

unavailable: Verified entrance coordinates and precise drawing-specific residence areas.
